questions.q: Which nation is Obadiah's vision about?
According to the prophecy, what has deceived Edom?
Why does God say shame will cover Edom?
options: For the violence done to its brother Jacob
For worshiping the gods of Moab
For robbing travelers on the roads
For attacking the city of Teman

questions.q: Who does the prophecy say deceived Edom and prevailed against it?
options: The men of its own alliance

questions.q: What comparison shows Edom will be stripped more completely than usual?
options: Grape pickers would at least leave gleanings
Locusts would at least leave the roots
A fire would at least spare the stubble
Shepherds would at least leave the lambs

questions.q: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set ____, I will bring you down from there.
wrong: on the top of the cliffs

questions.q: As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return ____.
The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau ____.
The prophecy warns Edom not to rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction.
The chapter ends by saying saviors will go up on Mount Sinai to judge the mountains of Esau.
